note: Examples for the schema, not game content. An ambition is a promise a life makes to itself; the heir inherits the saying if it was kept and the shame if it was not.

items.title: Keep the family's field
items.offeredTo: age >= 16 and age <= 24 and hero.station.id == 'common' and knows('parent') and not flag('field_sold')
items.fulfilled: age >= 50 and not flag('field_sold') and debt == 0
items.saying: The field was {hero.name}'s and {hero.their} father's before that, and it is yours now, and the only thing anyone in this family has ever asked of the next one is that it stay so.
items.shame: {hero.name} sold the field, or let it be taken, which comes to the same in a village. People still call it by the old name, and look at you when they do.

turns.text: The lender's man has started to walk the field's edge on his way through, looking at the soil the way lenders do.
The field has another name on the roll. The promise is broken, and the village knows the day it broke.

turns.when: age >= 45 and debt == 0 and not flag('field_sold')
turns.text: Thirty years of it. The field is yours, clear, and nobody's man walks its edge. {parent.name} would not have said so, and would have thought it.
